description: This file declares functions, structures, and helpers for handling constants within the Torch JIT IR, including creating constant nodes from various data types, converting Values to IValues, and error handling related to unsupported constants.
external_methods: template <typename T> std::optional<T> constant_as(const Value* v)

classes.name: constant_not_supported_error
classes.description: Exception class thrown when inserting a constant value that cannot be encoded in the IR.

methods.name: insertConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant node in the IR graph from an IValue, with optional source location and scope.

methods.name: tryInsertConstant
methods.description: Attempts to insert a constant into the IR graph from an IValue; returns std::nullopt if unsupported.

methods.name: toIValue
methods.description: Converts a Value* to an optional IValue if the Value is a constant.

methods.name: std::optional<T> constant_as(const Value * v)
methods.description: Template function that attempts to convert a constant Value* to a specific type T.
